description: Canadian federal open datasets from open.canada.ca (CKAN API): title, publisher, licence, last modified date, number of resources and dataset link, for a search term. Catalogue metadata only, not the data files. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_dati_gov_it_italy_open_data when you need Italian open government datasets from dati.gov.it: title; gov_royallepage_canada when you need Royal LePage homes for sale in a city: listing id, MLS. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: gov_canada_open_data
title: Canadian federal open datasets from open.canada.ca: title
